The range

## Seven bags, and what each one is for

Paper and card only. If a job needs something we do not make, we will say so rather than sell you the nearest thing.

[![Kraft paper bags](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Shoes-1.jpg)\\
\\
**Kraft paper bags** \\
\\
Unbleached brown kraft, 180-250gsm. The everyday British carrier: strong, cheap to print, recyclable with the paper.\\
\\
_Twisted, rope or die-cut handles_](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/printed-luxury-kraft-bags/) [![Laminated bags](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Hair-Beauty-2.jpg)\\
\\
**Laminated bags** \\
\\
Matt or gloss film over the print. Holds colour under rain and handling, so it suits salons, hotels and premium retail.\\
\\
_Rope or ribbon handles_](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/luxury-laminated/) [![Un-laminated bags](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Menswear-1.jpg)\\
\\
**Un-laminated bags** \\
\\
Coated board with no film. A quieter, paper-first finish that boutiques tend to prefer.\\
\\
_Ribbon or cotton handles_](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/printed-luxury-un-laminated/) [![Twisted handle bags](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Tourism-Travel-1.jpg)\\
\\
**Twisted handle bags** \\
\\
Machine made or overprinted, white or brown kraft. The workhorse of the high street counter.\\
\\
_Twisted paper handles_](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/printed-twisted-handle-bags/) [![Folded handle bags](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Food-Drink.jpg)\\
\\
**Folded handle bags** \\
\\
Flat paper handles glued inside or out. Packs down small, stacks well, carries a full order without tearing.\\
\\
_Internal or external handles_](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/printed-folded-handle-bags/) [![Rope handle bags](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Hotels-Spas-1.jpg)\\
\\
**Rope handle bags** \\
\\
Heavier board with cotton or PP rope. What you reach for when the bag has to look like part of the product.\\
\\
_Rope, ribbon or herringbone_](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/luxury-rope-handle-paper-bags/) [![Counter & block bottom](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Medical-1.jpg)\\
\\
**Counter & block bottom** \\
\\
Flat counter bags and block bottom bags that stand open while you fill them. Greaseproof stock available.\\
\\
_No handles, strung or unstrung_](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/printed-counter-bags/)

How it works

## From enquiry to delivered bags

### Tell us the job

Bag type or just what you are packing, the size in millimetres if you know it, and the quantity.

### We price it

A price for that exact job, with the stock and handle we would use and what the deadline allows.

### Proof

Our studio sets the artwork on the die for your size and sends a PDF proof. Nothing moves until you approve it.

### Press and delivery

Litho, flexo or digital depending on the run, then delivered anywhere in the UK.

Get a price

## Tell us the bag, the size and the quantity

We price the job in front of us rather than selling a package. Artwork can follow later; the quote does not wait for it.

### Or speak to the print desk

**0207 993 6533** [Call the office](tel:+442079936533)

**help@custompaperbagsco.co.uk** [Email artwork and quantities](mailto:help@custompaperbagsco.co.uk)

Not sure which bag? Send a photograph of what you are packing and we will come back with the stock, the handle and a size that fits it.

[Find my bag](https://www.custompaperbagsco.co.uk/find-my-bag/)

Questions

## Asked before most orders

_+_ What size should I order?

Measure the product, add a little for a hand going in, and send width × gusset × height in millimetres. If you would rather not measure, send a photograph of what you are packing and we will specify it.

_+_ Do you print on brown kraft and white?

Both, smooth or ribbed. Brown kraft takes one and two colour work beautifully; white or coated board is the one to use for photographic print.

_+_ Can I have a sample before ordering?

Yes, samples are free. Say which bags you want to see and where to send them.

_+_ What artwork do you need?

Vector is best: .cdr, .eps or a print-ready PDF in CMYK. A logo file or even a sketch is enough to start the quote.

_+_ Are the bags recyclable?

Uncoated paper and board go in kerbside recycling. A laminated bag has a film over the board, so it depends on local facilities - ask us for the stock specification on your job and we will tell you what is on it.

_+_ Do you deliver outside London?

Yes, anywhere in the UK. Delivery is confirmed with your quote.

## Why choose collapsible rigid boxes?

They do the same job as a standard rigid box, with less cost before the box reaches your customer.

Lower freightFlat boxes take a fraction of the space in transit.

Less storageStack them on a shelf until you need them.

Quick to assembleLift the walls, press the corners, close the lid.

Same luxury feelThick board, wrapped and finished like any rigid box.

## What are collapsible rigid boxes?

A collapsible rigid box is a rigid box with hinged walls. It is made from the same thick paperboard as a standard rigid box and wrapped in printed or specialty paper, so it has the same weight and finish. The difference is in how it travels. A standard rigid box is delivered fully formed and takes up its full volume in a carton and on a shelf. A collapsible box is delivered folded flat and is assembled by hand in a few seconds, usually with a magnetic flap that holds the lid shut.

Brands use collapsible rigid boxes for cosmetics, jewelry, apparel, candles, electronics and gift sets, and for PR mailers and subscription orders where presentation matters as much as protection.

## Frequently asked questions

What is a collapsible rigid box?

A rigid box with hinged walls. It folds flat for shipping and storage and is assembled by hand when needed.

Is it as strong as a standard rigid box?

It is made from the same thick board. Once assembled, the walls lock in place and the box holds its shape.

How long does one box take to assemble?

A few seconds. Lift the walls, press the corners into place and close the lid.

Can you print inside the box?

Yes. The inside of the lid and walls can be printed, and inserts can be made to hold your product.

Can I order a custom size?

Yes. Every box is made to order around your product's dimensions.

What is the minimum order?

The minimum order is 50 boxes, and prices start from $1 per box. The unit price falls as the quantity rises.

## What types of swing tags do you print?

Swing tags, clothing and apparel tags, gift tags, bottle neck tags, luggage tags, fold-over tags, jewellery tags and custom die-cut shapes. If you need a shape that is not on the site, send the outline and we cut to it.

## What is the minimum order?

One hundred tags, per design. If you need two different tags, each is its own run of 100.

## How much do custom swing tags cost?

Pricing starts at £0.02 per tag. What you pay depends on the stock, the size, how many colours you print and which finishes you add — foiling and embossing cost more than plain printing. Send the specification and the quote comes back itemised.

## Which materials can I choose?

Recycled kraft, art paper, premium card, leather, waterproof PVC and silkscreen fabric. Tell us how the tag will be handled and we will recommend a stock.

## Can you cut a shape of my own?

Yes. Send the outline you want and it is produced as a custom die-cut, in any size.

## Will I see a proof before it is printed?

Yes. Our design team creates a digital proof from your requirements, and nothing goes on press until you approve it.

## How long does printing and delivery take?

Ten to twelve working days from artwork approval, then delivery across the UK.

Why AStickerPrinting

## Straight answers before you order

How ordering works, what we need from you, and what happens between your quote and delivery.

### Frequently asked questions

How long does sticker printing take?

Typical turnaround is 10–12 working days, depending on the product, quantity and customisation. The time starts from the day you approve your artwork and digital proof. If you need faster delivery, contact us before you order.

Will I see a proof before my stickers are printed?

Yes. We send a PDF proof for approval, so you can check the design before printing. Production goes ahead exactly as approved, so review the proof carefully.

What artwork files should I send?

Supply artwork in CMYK at a minimum of 300 DPI, with 3mm of bleed on every side. We accept .cdr and .eps files in CMYK layers, and you can send a PDF for a quick look first.

Can you print stickers in a custom size or shape?

Yes. Give us the finished size in millimetres. For die-cut shapes, supply the design with the cutting line drawn as a 1mm black line on a white background.

Do you deliver across the UK?

Yes, we deliver UK-wide. We aim to ship orders straight after they are printed.

![Roll of printed clear vinyl warning stickers being peeled](https://www.astickerprinting.com.au/media/catalog/category/1513972807-Clear-Vinyl-Roll-Stickers_1.jpg)

Why order here

## How ordering custom stickers works

A quote-led process: you tell us what you need, check a proof, and only then do we print.

How do I get a price for my stickers?

Use the custom quotation form. Include the size, shape, material if you know it, quantity and your artwork. Prices depend on those details, so a quote is the accurate way to price your order.

What happens after I send my artwork?

We prepare a PDF proof and email it to you. Check the wording, layout and colours, then confirm it is approved for printing. Production starts from the day you approve the proof.

Can you design the sticker for me?

Yes. Design support is free. Send a logo, a photo or a rough idea and we will set up the artwork with you before the proof stage.

Is there a charge for dies or printing plates?

No. Die and plate set-up is not charged separately, including for die cut shapes made to the outline of your design.

Can a rush order be arranged?

If you have a deadline, contact us before you order so we can tell you what is possible for your job. Delays in approving artwork move the delivery date, so approving your proof promptly helps.

Not sure which bag? Send a photograph of what you are packing and we will come back with the stock, the handle and a size that fits it.

Questions

## Asked before most orders

_+_ What size should I order?

Measure the product, allow a little for a hand going in, and send width × gusset × height in millimetres. If you would rather not measure, send a photograph of what you are packing and we will specify it.

_+_ Can you print on brown kraft and white stock?

Both, smooth or ribbed. Brown kraft is ideal for one and two colour work; white or coated board is the one for photographic print.

_+_ Do you supply samples?

Yes. Tell us which bags you want to see and where to send them.

_+_ What artwork do you need?

Vector is best — .cdr, .eps or a print-ready PDF in CMYK. A logo file or a sketch is enough to begin a quote.

_+_ Which finishes are available?

Matt and gloss lamination, foil blocking, embossing and debossing, eyelets, and a choice of twisted paper, rope, ribbon or cotton handles.

_+_ Do you deliver outside Sydney?

Yes, anywhere in Australia. Delivery is confirmed with your quote.

## Why choose collapsible rigid boxes?

They do the same job as a standard rigid box, with less cost before the box reaches your customer.

Lower freightFlat boxes take a fraction of the space in transit.

Less storageStack them on a shelf until you need them.

Quick to assembleLift the walls, press the corners, close the lid.

Same luxury feelThick board, wrapped and finished like any rigid box.

## Not sure which box fits your product?

Tell us what you are packing and we will suggest the size, board and insert.

[Contact our team](https://rigidboxesco.com.au/custom-quotation/)

## What are collapsible rigid boxes?

A collapsible rigid box is a rigid box with hinged walls. It is made from the same thick paperboard as a standard rigid box and wrapped in printed or speciality paper, so it has the same weight and finish. The difference is in how it travels. A standard rigid box is delivered fully formed and takes up its full volume in a carton and on a shelf. A collapsible box is delivered folded flat and is assembled by hand in a few seconds, usually with a magnetic flap that holds the lid shut.

Brands use collapsible rigid boxes for cosmetics, jewellery, apparel, candles, electronics and gift sets, and for PR mailers and subscription orders where presentation mattrs as much as protection.

## Frequently asked questions

What is a collapsible rigid box?

A rigid box with hinged walls. It folds flat for shipping and storage and is assembled by hand when needed.

Is it as strong as a standard rigid box?

It is made from the same thick board. Once assembled, the walls lock in place and the box holds its shape.

How long does one box take to assemble?

A few seconds. Lift the walls, press the corners into place and close the lid.

Can you print inside the box?

Yes. The inside of the lid and walls can be printed, and inserts can be made to hold your product.

Can I order a custom size?

Yes. Every box is made to order around your product's dimensions.

What is the minimum order?

The minimum order is 50 boxes, and prices start from A$2 per box. The unit price falls as the quantity rises.
